prompt: Create an authentic pixel-art animation sprite sheet for the EXACT small hooded courier in reference: burnt-orange hood/scarf, black face recess with one ivory oval eye, charcoal coat, brass buttons, brown gloves and boots. Same proportions and fine detailed Underworld pixel clusters, not a redesigned character. Transparent background. Sheet 4 columns x 3 rows, twelve equally spaced cells, each character fully contained with generous empty margin, NO text, no grid, no scenery, no ground or wall drawn, no weapon. Facing right in every cell. ROW1 and ROW2 together form eight successive distinct anatomically drawn wake-up poses: 1 lying face-down prone on belly, head to right resting on forearm, legs extended left and scarf pooled; 2 waking raising head slightly while still prone; 3 both hands planted pressing chest up with elbows bent; 4 arms extended lifting chest, one knee drawn beneath belly; 5 kneeling on one knee torso half-upright; 6 pushing off bent front knee into deep crouch; 7 nearly standing still hunched slightly; 8 original standing idle proportions. All these grounded poses share a consistent bottom ground baseline inside their cell. Draw actual changing limbs, spine and fabric; never rotate an upright sprite to fake lying. ROW3 four consecutive wall-clinging poses: the character's face, reaching gloved hands and bent knees point right toward an implied wall just outside its rightmost hand/boot; 1 catch with upper hand extended high and lower hand close to face, feet braced; 2 elbows flex under weight and knees tuck; 3 settled cling both hands gripping with scarf hanging to left; 4 gradual slide hands and boots still on right wall with scarf lifting subtly. No wall pixels. Maintain a consistent same-body size across all 12 frames, no independent pose resizing; prone pose is naturally much wider and lower than upright. Crisp dark outlines, controlled amber highlights, no glow, no shadows outside character. Transparent RGBA.
